title: Loose Ends: TODO tree without ripgrep
description: Every TODO, FIXME and HACK comment in your workspace in one list, with highlights. Uses VS Code's own file APIs instead of a ripgrep binary, so updates don't break it. Reads your Todo Tree tags. No telemetry.

title: ABI Explorer
description: Sizes, offsets and padding of C and C++ structs in hovers and a layout view, from your project's own compile flags.

title: attestqa
description: Governed agentic testing in VS Code: write Playwright tests from Jira or Azure DevOps stories, approve the test design in the editor, and read coverage and the run ledger. A client of the attestqa CLI.

title: Nebula Drift Dawn
description: A clean white and magenta light color theme with a space-themed file icon set: comets, aliens, planets and rockets.
